chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from 'Asim al-Khayyat, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him), who said:

One who recites Surah al-Muddaththir in the obligatory prayer, it becomes a duty upon Allah, the Exalted and Mighty, to place him with Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) in his rank, and misfortune will not overtake him in his worldly life forever, God willing.

key_terms.حَقًّا عَلَى اللَّهِ: A duty/right upon Allah (a theological concept of divine obligation)
key_terms.سُورَة الْمُدَّثِّر: Surah al-Muddaththir (The Cloaked One), the 74th chapter of the Quran
key_terms.مُحَمَّد ص: Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for reciting Surah al-Muddaththir in obligatory prayer?
ai.summary: In *Thawab al-A'mal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this hadith from Imam al-Baqir, emphasizing the spiritual merit of reciting Surah al-Muddaththir specifically within the obligatory prayer. The promise of being 'with the Prophet' signifies a high rank of proximity and intercession, while protection from 'perpetual misfortune' reflects the Surah's theme of divine deliverance from worldly trials for the faithful.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from ’Asim al-Khayyat from Muhammad b. Muslim from Abi Ja’far Muhammad al-Baqir (a.s.) who said:

Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.), “One who recites Surah Muddassir in his obligatory Salaat it is the duty of Allah to give him a status along with Muhammad (s.a.w.s.) and he will not face any difficulty in his worldly life, God-Willing.”
